## Body

PR #239, round 1 at 91e7d311e29f577235f4c859d19e0e888955b95c: reviewer block on two source-proven correctness issues. F001: refresh snapshots account/generation before awaiting gh but installs into the current Held without comparison, while account reload uses a different lock. A's late refresh can leave B's account label with A's valid token. Test with account-specific tokens and deterministic fetch barriers. F002: a 402 marks exhausted/recheck, but the next status can clear it using a lagging usable quota snapshot. Keep the observed refusal independent and test lag explicitly.

Exact-head CI run 44225036106 succeeded: 2465 Rust tests passed, 6 skipped in nextest; successful job 134536017451 uploaded artifact 14391968226, with all 26 sidecar tests and the CLI port test present. pr-freeze returned FINAL. No local builds, test/mutation executions, credentials or sidecar starts. The author confirmed no mutation receipts. C34 makes mutation/proof-hardening follow-ups optional, not new blockers.
